title: brain.eval-case.v1
description: 07-brain-architecture.md section 7.11's corpus format: '{case_id, description, contract: brain.task.v1, fixture: {repo_tar or git ref}, expected: {status, verdicts, max_cost_usd}}'. `contract` is deliberately loosely typed HERE ({type: object}) -- evals.ts's own validateEvalCase() separately runs it through contracts.ts's validateTaskContract (the single source of truth for brain.task.v1), rather than duplicating that schema via a cross-file $ref.

repo_tar.description: Path to a packed repo tarball fixture. V1 gap: capture never populates this (see evals.ts's own header comment); reserved for a future issue that needs a frozen, non-live repo snapshot rather than a real git ref.

git_ref.description: A resolvable ref in contract.repo -- V1's actual supported fixture strategy: the case simply re-dispatches contract.repo at this ref.

verdicts.description: Optional subset check: every {id, pass} listed here must match the corresponding verdict in the fresh run's own result exactly. A verdict id absent from `expected.verdicts` is not checked (the grader does not require an exhaustive list).
